Why Amodei Is Worried About China

Amodei, speaking with CBS News’ “Sunday Morning,” highlighted the challenges of implementing a global AI speed limit, citing military advantages as a key factor. Despite uncertainties about feasibility, he emphasized the importance of attempting such measures.

"The more long-term thing would be working together to put a speed limit on the rate of AI progress. I think that’s going to be very difficult because the incentives to pull ahead and the military advantage that you get from that are so large. And honestly, I don’t know if it’s possible, but we should try," he said.
